تستنزفون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْزِفُونَ (tastanzifūna) /tas.tan.zi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# تُسْتَنْزَفُونَ (tustanzafūna) /tus.tan.za.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
